links.outcome: Calibration of depression severity predictions across socioeconomic status subgroups
links.effect: Robust SES-related calibration gap replicated across supervised models and GPT-4o zero-shot; predictions track depression severity more closely for lower-SES participants.
links.quote: Critically, we find a robust SES-related calibration gap replicated across supervised models and GPT-4o zero-shot estimation: predictions track depression severity more closely for lower-SES participants, suggesting the gap reflects genuine socioeconomic differences in linguistic expression of distress.

unlisted_practices: Comparing typed versus spoken interaction modality for AI depression screening
Adding acoustic features to text-based depression screening models

screen.reason: Evaluates M2SurveyBot with 455 participants to test how interaction modality (speech vs typing) affects AI depression screening performance, self-disclosure, and socioeconomic calibration equity.

primary.practice: interaction modality selection (speech vs text input)
